---
title: MIR 1.2.0 F200 migration-origin source fixture
---

This source-only fixture prepares one disposable Factorio2.0.77 save from the exact published `more-infinite-research`1.2.0 archive. It is not a migration pass, current-package result, performance result, or release qualification.

The independent source facts are the selected objects from the existing native Defaults capture: data SHA-256 `7714C28BE891B81D3F8A598697F52DD0A678E3F3493600A96ECB7D7F1563745D`, settings SHA-256 `C512FBFDC2240D481B6A21E30764E1C82BAF2EC5238C01E6B2C4C80F0142C3C8`, and selected projection SHA-256 `A017240FA9AF6E438462F5417397DBC3768AE1CC0BDB0DF5EE9D5313E593F98F`. The fixture verifies all 34 MIR rows, their formula/time, ingredients, prerequisites and effect multisets, all 177 startup setting prototype type/default rows, and native `weapon-shooting-speed-1` through `-7` effect vectors before the only acceleration write.

It seeds 33 non-gear MIR levels plus player `weapon-shooting-speed-1` through `-6`; the foreign witness earns only `weapon-shooting-speed-1` and the detached witness earns none. It records those scripted seeds, completes one real gear laboratory, then retains source recipe, worker-battery, rocket/cannon/electric/flamethrower/bullet/shotgun gun-speed, foreign queued`.42`, detached`.27`, and all seven native weapon states through the protected save and two read-only cold reloads. Owners1 through6 are finite at their native levels; owner7 remains an unresearched level7 infinite continuation. The earned source state is input for a separately reviewed successor; this fixture does not select or qualify a destination repair.

The raw-Git r01 preparation from commit `998f298056a43fd31cdeb49a4e061aa82e19b299` remains preserved: its five-member fixture archive is SHA-256 `303E8A24151513F425AC95706B81AE6DC1BE1A0019BB0E363B8EAAAE1779A519`, 10,077 bytes. It was never executed and does not contain the required finite-owner source state. The r02 raw-Git package from `0df1119472b3ca20fc075908dd6ec9d8bb702e54` carries the finite-owner state in the same five members: SHA-256 `38CC9761DD67D3E13F2BCF12EE5DE3BFC9A1727FC0B424E77B510A473DB40BE7`, 10,232 bytes. Neither preparation is a native result.

The r03 raw-Git package from `2869b019753b7708ef70bd1c8af395d9678d2a4b` remains an unexecuted preparation: SHA-256 `88911241A3EFBF8DD86A006ADB43B938304E4AE2AD689F9A2D294F1C9816A5FE`, 10,508 bytes. It retains the r02 finite-owner scope and additionally checks the actual Base runtime level/max-level boundaries for every `weapon-shooting-speed` member. The r01, r02 and r03 preparations remain unexecuted and are not relabelled.

The r04 raw-Git package from `f6606cf05400f02252e0f49bea9dd0a5653645dc`, SHA-256 `725FB5E6F3E3BD1D2D1BC23C4290B76A969779763109272A95E20E64CF6F55CC` (10,912 bytes), failed its runtime comparison during native initialization before a lab or protected save. The r05 package from `17d83ab9e30baae2a3d64d9d5d52536aa20371c9`, SHA-256 `3B2A1F6536EAB31EB7B8BE2463BF6310E289F4762F3007F1D4706A92AD7F6713` (11,391 bytes), passed runtime guards and one player gear lab, then failed when its compound queue/progress assignment attempted active progress before installing research. Its seeded create archive is not a qualifying source save. Both original adverse receipts remain preserved.

The [r06 source chain](../../../../spec/evidence/migration-origin-120-f200-source-native-chain-r06.json) passes the corrected five-member fixture from raw Git `e26bb227bf46f626964d1f3bfe272a6b36832c4d`, SHA-256 `529B53C63715905849DC27D042BDBD9FD4778DC137BC58630A49578E4FD3C659` (11,555 bytes), on full controller `2eb20527ce3063fde0c7151985a021afc29bf7ca`. Numeric preflight aliases use the active engine formatter on both sides; native queue setup uses explicit ordered writes. Original published MIR1.2.0/880C on Factorio2.0.77/D3 earns one source gear lab and saves `FDC9BA445B17716CAE7C021959B9B3BF4E1C7EE9F6485AA76DBCC59D70101CAC` (817,810 bytes), then passes two independent read-only cold reloads with unchanged save bytes. All 23 original/primary native members (1,893,949 bytes) are independently rehashed. The source lab is counted once; direct successor qualification remains open.

The source controller emits one plain JSON observation before its first protected save, containing the actual startup values and collected player/foreign/detached technology, recipe, worker-battery and gun-speed snapshots. The foreign queue is read from its live force; assertions check all saved witness state before export. Raw runtime effect spellings are retained, with finite float32 aliases used only for preflight comparison. No observation is re-emitted on ordinary ticks or cold reloads.

The gear laboratory uses the sole accelerated technology row (`count=1`, `time=1`); the foreign gear queue uses that same row. This prepares earned source state and tests its preservation, not ordinary published gear cost/time or unaccelerated queued work. No destination repair is selected or qualified.
